# AI Coloring Book Prompts

> 335 free, validated AI prompts for coloring books, story coloring books, illustrated children's picture books, activity books (mazes, word search, sudoku, tracing), educational coloring books and Amazon KDP covers. Each prompt is a brief with age band, page count, page size and style, and opens in InkChamps (https://inkchamps.com) with one click to make a print-ready PDF.

Browse: https://inkchamps.com/prompts/ · Full data with exact InkChamps order settings: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gunjchhetri/ai-coloring-book-prompts/main/prompts.json
